content.overview: Three older adults and three children are together in a flower-filled garden. One child sits on a rope swing while an older man holds both ropes, and the other children stand near two older women beside a picnic area.

grammar.title: Comparative structures for generational differences
grammar.explainer: Use comparatives to describe generations without stereotypes. Bind the comparison to this image or moment: “The children are younger and more physically active in this moment; the older adults are participating differently.” Do not turn one scene into a general claim about all older adults or children.
examples: The children are younger than the older adults.
In this moment, the children are more physically active.
The older adults are participating differently rather than less meaningfully.

models.A1–A2: Six people are together in a garden. Three are older adults and three are children. A small child is sitting on a swing, and an older man is holding the ropes. There are many flowers, bubbles, and a picnic table with food and drinks.
models.B1–B2: Three older adults and three children are spending time together in a flower-filled garden. An older man stands behind a rope swing and holds both ropes while a small barefoot child sits on the wooden seat. Near the center, a girl stands beside a kneeling older woman who is holding a bubble wand and a small container. A boy stands nearby, and a picnic table with drinks and food fills the right side of the scene.
models.C1–C2: The image connects several areas of activity within one richly planted garden. On the left, an older man steadies a rope swing while a small child sits barefoot on the wooden seat. In the center, a girl and a kneeling older woman interact around a bubble wand, while another child stands nearby. To the right, a picnic table, food, drinks, pale roses, hydrangeas, and sunflowers add layers of detail. The visible scene supports shared recreation across age groups, while exact relationships and the reason for the gathering remain outside the photograph.
